## Use Martian Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Martian Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Martian Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

Copy

Martian Mono is available from Google Fonts.

[Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Martian+Mono)

## About the Martian Mono coding font

A variable monospace built for dense interfaces and code. Martian Mono is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Martian Mono is hosted on Google Fonts, so the specimen above renders without installing anything locally. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Martian Mono FAQ

### Is Martian Mono free?

Yes. Martian Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Martian Mono support ligatures?

No. Martian Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Martian Mono?

Martian Mono is available from Google Fonts. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
